title: Circuit breaker state cards
acceptance: Terminal failure and cooling-down are visually and textually distinct; terminal never shows a countdown.
The countdown ticks locally between refreshes and reconciles to authoritative values without drift.
health_score is never presented as a success percentage; null rates read as 'not yet called'.
Reset buttons are disabled while in flight so a double-click cannot fire twice.
Cards already present do not replay their entrance animation on a poll refresh.
Ordering comparator, countdown reconciliation, and formatters are exported pure functions with tests.
